title: Uncertainty Quantification Using Conformal Prediction for Mesh-Based Simulations
description: Code and artifacts for post-hoc split conformal prediction on autoregressive surrogate (MeshGraphNet) rollouts for mesh-based physics simulations. Implements L2, L-infinity, Mahalanobis, adaptive, and component-wise adaptive conformal score functions, and reports empirical coverage and prediction-set efficiency under temporal and spatial dependence on the CylinderFlow (CFD) and Flag (cloth) datasets. Includes trained TensorFlow 1.x MeshGraphNet checkpoints (step 200,000) for both datasets.
